title: 第2章 悲剧的穿越？
content_zh:
四个侍卫都打累了，但是上官羽仍然没有屈服。他们不得不承认，上官羽的意志实在是太强了。

上官羽仍然一脸淡然，这些根本不能对他造成任何影响。“你们四个继续，这些对我来说实在不怎么样！”

“看来不能叫他废物羽了，这份意志我自愧不如！”

“是啊，我们有几个人能做到他这种程度？”

围观的学员议论纷纷，武子明的脸色越来越难看了。本来想给上官羽一个教训，让他当众出丑，没想到反而成全了他。他实在没想到，上官羽竟然能忍受得住四个侍卫的毒打。

眼见事情越闹越大，武子明给四个侍卫打了个眼色，极度郁闷的走掉了。他实在不想呆下去了，上官羽那种韧性他自认不如。

“三哥，你怎么受伤了呀？不要吓倾城好么？”

只见一个粉雕玉琢的小女孩跑了过来，粉嫩的小脸上挂满了担心。小女孩来到上官羽身边，想将上官羽拉起来。

上官羽向小女孩挤出了一个笑脸，忍受着全身剧痛站了起来。“倾城乖啦，三哥没事的，只是摔了一跤而已。”

“三哥别逗我啦，你肯定是被坏人欺负了，回去让爹爹教训他们！”小女孩挥动粉色的小拳头，仿佛能打跑一切坏人。

这个小女孩如今六岁了，是上官惊鸿的小女儿上官倾城，也是上官羽最疼爱的妹妹。

“倾城，你快点回家，这个废物不是你哥哥！他根本不是我们上官家的人，不信你回去问爹。”

上官建城不知道什么时候走了过来，看着上官倾城的样子直皱眉。他走了过去，一把拽走了上官倾城。

“二哥，你放开我！他是我三哥，也是你弟弟，你怎么这样呀？”

“你们两个过来，帮我把小姐送回家。”上官建城对着上官羽的两个侍卫说道。

两个侍卫也不敢多说，只得抱起上官倾城往学院门口走去。

“放开我，你们放开我呀，我要和三哥在一起，你们快点放手……”

上官倾城一直在挣扎，但是仅仅六岁的她，又怎么能从两个侍卫手里逃得掉呢？

“倾城乖，三哥没事，你赶快回家吧。三哥回家还要带倾城玩呢。”

果然，上官羽一句话就让小倾城平静下来了，也让两个护卫松了一口气。“那三哥快回来，倾城等三哥带我玩！”

上官倾城向着上官羽挥了挥小手，恋恋不舍的走进了马车。

整个上官家，上官羽就和这个妹妹关系最好。上官倾城从小就喜欢黏着上官羽，喜欢和他一起玩，喜欢和他在一起。上官羽也是使出浑身解数，哄这个妹妹开心，两人比亲兄妹还亲。

马车渐行渐远，上官羽目送着马车，直至消失在视线中。

上官羽淡然的看了上官建城一眼，就仿佛看陌生人一样。而上官建城看上官羽，更是和看仇人一样。这两人怎么看都不像是兄弟俩，外貌不像，感情更不像。

上官建城看着上官羽也觉得奇怪，为什么上官羽每次受那么重的伤第二天都能痊愈？他已经限制下人，不让上官羽找医者治疗的。那他到底是怎么治伤的呢？

上官羽忍受着身体的剧痛，一瘸一拐的离开了。今天被四个侍卫这样揍，他是憋了一肚子火。也更激发了他变强的信念，强者生存，弱者淘汰。

这个世界，武力至上，律法根本管不了武道高深的人。飞羽王朝也是以武治国，只要是武道修为足够，完全可以凌驾于律法之上。

别人觉得本来就该是这种现象，但上官羽肯定不会这么觉得。

他有着前世的记忆，来自于地球的二十一世纪。这具身体十二岁，但是他只有十年的记忆。不知道为什么，前两年的记忆很模糊，始终记不起来。

记得前世的最后一天，天空下着滂沱大雨，电闪雷鸣。他前世也就一个普通的大学生，平时喜欢看看小说，打打游戏。生活过的实在是无聊，那天下雨也是刚从网吧出来。

他就想了，要是雷劈到他，然后让他穿越就好了。真的是穿越小说看多了，下雨还能想到这些，不得不佩服他的神经之大。

他还想，要是能穿越到异世大陆，然后炼成绝世神功，长生不死，再娶几个美女老婆。越想越爽，忍不住大吼：“劈我吧，我要穿越！”

然而可能雷神看他可怜，或者实在是狗屎运。

最狗血和最不可思议的事情发生了，一道雷劈向了他。等他再次睁开眼睛，就在这个世界了，他成功穿越了。

前世是孤儿，又没有娶妻生子，他也没什么牵挂。后来更是知道，这个世界就和他想象的一样，武道强盛，谁拳头大就听谁的。当时他就兴奋了，看了那么多穿越小说，穿越者都会有大成就的。

穿越者，要么天赋卓绝，要么有神秘老师，要么身怀神器，要么有特殊体质。反正就是会特别厉害的那种，他也找了很多疑为古物的东西，甚至去一些神秘的地方，希望能有所奇遇。

然而事实令他绝望了，这些他都没有。更悲剧的是，他竟然不能修炼！他开始不信，以为自己体质特殊，的确，他的身体异于常人。可是渐渐地，他发现他的确不能修炼，武者修的天地元气，跟他一点关系都没有。

可是上官羽是个不甘平凡的人，他渴望扬名立万，渴望万人敬仰。因此他必须要变强，如果永远不能修炼，那别说那些，就是好好生存下来也是妄想。

这个世界，他是有父母的。他能感觉到父母对他的爱，母爱似海，父爱如山。前世他没有感受过，今世没有清楚地记忆，但是却能感受到。

这个世界无比广袤，他必须足够强大，才能去找寻自己的父母。不说种种危险，就是距离也让他绝望。如果是靠马车，哪怕耗尽他一辈子，他也走不到这个世界的另一端。

只有传说中的大神通者，咫尺天涯，相隔无尽遥远，一步也可抵达。只有达到那样的境界，他才有可能找寻的到自己的父母。

不能踏入武道一途，他就努力修炼肉身。他也不是没有优势，他的肉体就是奇异之处。

每次受伤，他恢复的都特别快。他那些皮肉伤，一夜就能好个干净。这就让他可以放心修炼了，反正就算受伤了，也能很快恢复过来。

而且他气力惊人，如今更是远超一般的成年人。他今年才十二岁，能达到这样的程度，已经是个奇迹了。

上官羽举起两块大石墩，往上抛飞，再用双手接住。这样锻炼是很危险的，不过对他的肉体没有什么压力。他可以让这两个大石墩，在他身上上下飞舞。

上官羽的修炼简直是玩命，每次都鲜血飞溅。他光脚踢一颗大树，可以踢到双脚上全是血沫。他双拳击打巨石，也可以打到骨断筋折。

正是这样不要命的修炼，才使得他肉体越来越强大。他并不满足，靠肉体力量在飞羽王朝当将军的也有。但是，上官羽的目标，可不是当飞羽王朝的将军。

上官羽仿佛并没有感到疼痛，继续疯狂的修炼着。

穿越到这个世界，他过得并不好。在他刚穿越过来的时候，上官惊鸿对他特别疼爱。可是三年之后，对他也就一般般了。直到发现他不能修炼武道，上官惊鸿更是完全不待见他了。

后来就被安排到下人的住处了，吃穿用度也和下人是一个档次的。上官建城更是在背后煽风点火，兴风作浪，很多下人甚至敢欺负他这个名义上的少爷了。

上官羽一遍一遍的挥拳，直拳，摆拳，勾拳，刺拳，鞭拳，一遍又一遍的练习。侧弹腿，正蹬腿，侧踹腿，扶地后扫腿，鞭腿，转身横扫腿，截腿，一遍一遍的重复。

没有疲倦，没有厌烦，只有一次一次的重复。他深深明白，武道一途，基础肯定是很重要的。地基不打好，怎么能盖摩天大厦？

前世由于好奇，看了不少武学方面的书。网络是那么发达，什么武学观念都有。再结合这个世界的武道知识，上官羽默默的按照自己的理解努力着。

他看过古籍，知道这个世界很大。飞羽王朝位于整个天玄大陆的东部，然而飞羽王朝只是一个小王朝而已。

对于目前的他来说，飞羽王朝是那么强大，但是他明白这只是他的层次不够。飞羽王朝只是在偏僻的地方，如果拉到其他地方，早就不知道被灭了多少次了。

如今想这些确实远了，上官羽摇了摇头，继续苦练了起来。在这个实力为尊的世界，一切只能靠实力说话。

“父亲，母亲，总有一天，孩儿必定会找到你们的！”上官羽在心里默默的念道。

银色的长河突然溅起一片水花，“小羽，你好了没啊？偶可都等的饿死了啊！”
content_en:
The four guards were all tired from fighting, but Shangguan Yu still did not surrender.They had to admit that Shangguan Yu's will was too strong.

Shangguan Yu still looked indifferent, these things could not have any impact on him at all."You four keep going, this doesn't look very good to me!"

"It seems that we can no longer call him Wasteful Yu. I am ashamed of his will!"

"Yeah, how many of us can do what he does?"

The onlookers were talking a lot, and Wu Ziming's face became increasingly ugly.I originally wanted to teach Shangguan Yu a lesson and make him embarrassed in public, but unexpectedly, it ended up helping him.He really didn't expect that Shangguan Yu could endure the beatings from the four guards.

Seeing that things were getting worse and worse, Wu Ziming winked at the four guards and walked away extremely depressed.He really didn't want to stay any longer, and he felt inferior to Shangguan Yu's toughness.

"Third brother, why are you injured? Don't scare Qingcheng, okay?"

I saw a pretty little girl running over, her pink face full of worry.The little girl came to Shangguan Yu and wanted to pull Shangguan Yu up.

Shangguan Yu smiled at the little girl and stood up despite the severe pain all over his body."Qingcheng, be good. Third brother is fine. He just fell down."

"Third brother, don't tease me. You must have been bullied by the bad guys. Go back and let daddy teach them a lesson!" The little girl waved her pink fists, as if she could beat away all the bad guys.

This little girl is now six years old. She is Shangguan Qingcheng, Shangguan Jinghong's youngest daughter, and Shangguan Yu's most beloved sister.

"Qingcheng, please go home quickly. This loser is not your brother! He is not from our Shangguan family at all. If you don't believe me, go back and ask dad."

Shangguan Jiancheng came over at some point and frowned at Shangguan Qingcheng's appearance.He walked over and dragged Shangguan Qingcheng away.

"Second brother, let me go! He is my third brother and your younger brother. Why are you like this?"

"You two come here and help me send the young lady home." Shangguan Jiancheng said to Shangguan Yu's two guards.

The two guards did not dare to say anything more, so they had no choice but to pick up Shangguan Qingcheng and walk to the entrance of the college.

"Let me go, let me go. I want to be with my third brother. Let me go quickly..."

Shangguan Qingcheng has been struggling, but how could she, who was only six years old, escape from the hands of two guards?

"Qingcheng, be good. Third brother is fine. You should go home quickly. Third brother wants to play with Qingcheng when he gets home."

Sure enough, Shangguan Yu's words calmed down Xiao Qingcheng and made the two guards breathe a sigh of relief."Then, third brother, come back quickly. Qingcheng is waiting for third brother to take me to play!"

Shangguan Qingcheng waved to Shangguan Yu and walked into the carriage reluctantly.

In the entire Shangguan family, Shangguan Yu has the best relationship with this younger sister.Shangguan Qingcheng has liked to stick to Shangguan Yu since she was a child, like to play with him and like to be with him.Shangguan Yu also tried his best to make this sister happy, and the two of them were closer than real brothers and sisters.

The carriage went further and further away, Shangguan Yu watched the carriage until it disappeared from sight.

Shangguan Yu glanced at Shangguan Jiancheng indifferently, as if looking at a stranger.Shangguan Jiancheng looked at Shangguan Yu as if he were an enemy.These two people don't look like brothers in any way. They don't look alike, and they don't even have the same feelings.

Shangguan Jiancheng looked at Shangguan Yu and felt strange. Why did Shangguan Yu recover the next day every time he suffered such a serious injury?He has restricted his servants and does not allow Shangguan Yu to seek treatment from a doctor.So how did he heal the injury?

Shangguan Yu endured the severe pain in his body and limped away.He was furious after being beaten like this by four guards today.It also inspired his belief in becoming stronger. The strong will survive and the weak will be eliminated.

In this world, force is supreme, and the law has no control over people with advanced martial arts.The Feiyu Dynasty also uses martial arts to rule the country. As long as one has sufficient martial arts skills, he can completely override the law.

Others think this should be the case, but Shangguan Yu definitely doesn't think so.

He has memories of his past life, coming from the twenty-first century on earth.This body is twelve years old, but he only has ten years of memory.I don’t know why, but my memory of the first two years is very fuzzy and I can’t remember it all.

I remember that on the last day of my previous life, it was raining heavily and there was lightning and thunder.In his previous life, he was just an ordinary college student who liked to read novels and play games.My life was really boring. It was raining that day and I had just come out of the Internet cafe.

He thought that it would be great if lightning struck him and allowed him to travel through time.He has really read too many time-travel novels, and he can still think of these things when it rains. I have to admire his nerves.

He also thought that if he could travel to a different world, develop a magical skill, live forever, and marry several beautiful wives.The more I thought about it, the more excited I became, and I couldn't help but yell: "Cut me, I want to travel through time!"

However, maybe Thor thought he was pitiful, or maybe he was really lucky.

The most outrageous and incredible thing happened, a bolt of lightning struck him.When he opened his eyes again, he was in this world, and he had successfully traveled through it.

He was an orphan in his previous life and had no wife or children, so he had nothing to worry about.Later, he learned that the world was just as he imagined, with strong martial arts and whoever had the big fist would listen to him.He was excited at that time. After reading so many time-travel novels, time-travelers would achieve great things.

Those who travel through time are either extremely talented, have mysterious teachers, possess magical weapons, or have special physiques.Anyway, he is the kind who is particularly powerful. He also found a lot of things that were suspected to be ancient relics, and even went to some mysterious places, hoping to have some adventures.

However, the fact made him despair, he had none of these.What's even more tragic is that he can't practice!He didn't believe it at first, thinking that he had a special constitution. Indeed, his body was different from ordinary people.But gradually, he discovered that he really couldn't practice, and the vitality of heaven and earth that warriors cultivated had nothing to do with him.

But Shangguan Yu was a man unwilling to be ordinary. He longed to become famous and admired by thousands of people.Therefore, he must become stronger. If he can never practice, let alone those things, even surviving well is just a delusion.

In this world, he has parents.He can feel the love his parents have for him. Mother's love is like the sea and father's love is like a mountain.He didn't feel it in his previous life, and he didn't remember it clearly in this life, but he could feel it.

This world is extremely vast, and he must be strong enough to find his parents.Not to mention the dangers, even the distance made him despair.If he relied on a carriage, even if it took his whole life, he would not be able to reach the other side of the world.

Only the legendary ones with great supernatural powers can reach them in one step even though they are so close to each other and so far apart.Only by reaching that state can he possibly find his parents.

Unable to enter the martial arts path, he worked hard to cultivate his body.It's not that he doesn't have advantages, his body is just weird.

Every time he gets injured, he recovers very quickly.His flesh wounds could be healed overnight.This allows him to practice with peace of mind. Even if he is injured, he can recover quickly.

Moreover, his strength is astonishing, and now it is far beyond that of ordinary adults.He is only twelve years old, and it is already a miracle that he can reach this level.

Shangguan Yu lifted two large stone piers, threw them upwards, and caught them with both hands.This kind of exercise is very dangerous, but it puts no pressure on his body.He can make these two big stone pillars fly up and down on him.

Shangguan Yu's training was simply life-threatening, with blood splattering every time.He kicked a big tree with his bare feet until his feet were covered in blood.He hit boulders with both fists and could break bones and tendons.

It is this kind of lifeless practice that makes his body stronger and stronger.He was not satisfied. There were also generals in the Feiyu Dynasty who relied on physical strength.However, Shangguan Yu's goal was not to become a general of the Feiyu Dynasty.

Shangguan Yu didn't seem to feel any pain and continued to practice crazily.

When he traveled to this world, he didn't have a good life.When he first crossed over, Shangguan Jinghong was particularly fond of him.But after three years, it was just so-so to him.Until he found out that he couldn't practice martial arts, Shangguan Jinghong didn't want to see him at all.

Later, I was arranged to live in a servant's residence, and the food and clothing expenses were on the same level as the servants.Shangguan Jiancheng even fanned the flames and stirred up trouble behind his back. Many servants even dared to bully him, the nominal young master.

Shangguan Yu practiced over and over again with punches, straight punches, swing punches, uppercuts, jabs, and whip punches.Side kick, forward kick, side kick, sweep the leg after holding on the ground, whip the leg, turn around and sweep the leg, amputate the leg, repeat over and over again.

No fatigue, no boredom, just repetition again and again.He deeply understands that in martial arts, the foundation must be very important.How can we build a skyscraper without laying a good foundation?

In my previous life, I read a lot of books on martial arts out of curiosity.The Internet is so developed that all kinds of martial arts concepts are available.Combined with the knowledge of martial arts in this world, Shangguan Yu silently worked hard according to his own understanding.

He has read ancient books and knows that the world is very big.Feiyu Dynasty is located in the eastern part of Tianxuan Continent, but Feiyu Dynasty is just a small dynasty.

For him currently, Feiyu Dynasty is so powerful, but he understands that this is just because his level is not enough.The Feiyu Dynasty was only in a remote place. If it had been moved to other places, it would have been destroyed countless times.

Now that he thought these things were far away, Shangguan Yu shook his head and continued to practice hard.In this world where strength is respected, everything can only be determined by strength.

"Father, mother, one day, the child will definitely find you!" Shangguan Yu thought silently in his heart.

The long silver river suddenly splashed with water, "Xiaoyu, are you okay? I'm so hungry to death from waiting!"
